name: Superior Machine & Welding, Inc.
old_description: Superior Machine and Welding is your Alaskan Family owned full service machine shop in Anchorage. We’ve been here on Ship Ave. since 1950 keeping all the industry in the state moving forward and we don’t plan on stopping.
about:
Superior Machine & Welding operates from a 10,000-square-foot facility on Ship Avenue in Anchorage, Alaska. The shop traces its roots to 1950 when Jack L. Whitmore purchased the original 3,400-square-foot operation and later reclaimed land from Ship Creek to expand. A 1964 addition brought the current footprint and added two Lodge & Shipley oil-country lathes and a five-ton overhead crane. Today the business is owned by Jantina Lunsford, a WOSB-certified woman owner and daughter of the previous proprietor, continuing the family-owned legacy.

The shop provides full-service machining, welding, and custom fabrication. Machining capacity includes two large-bore lathes with 28-inch swing and 40-foot material capacity, a five-axis and a three-axis horizontal boring mill, three Bridgeport-style knee mills with rotary tables, a two-axis CNC toolroom lathe, a custom-controlled CNC knee mill, a 4×8 CNC plasma/oxy-fuel cutter, an 18-inch Blanchard grinder holding ±0.00038 inch, a 24-inch vertical shaper for internal keyways, and 40- and 160-ton hydraulic presses for straightening. Welding covers TIG, MIG, stick, and brazing on materials from mild steel and aluminum to exotic alloys such as Inconel, Hastelloy, and titanium; the shop is noted for cast-iron repair and aluminum TIG work.

Customers span nearly every sector in Alaska: marine, heavy equipment, oilfield, trailers, wood-stove manufacturers, federal and military agencies, state and local government, corporations, and private citizens. The company emphasizes that local presence offsets higher pricing versus Lower-48 shops by eliminating shipping delays and providing rapid turnaround.

Founded to keep Alaskan industry moving, the shop differentiates itself through geographic necessity—local service that avoids weeks of freight transit—and a guarantee to rework any defect at no charge. The current owner’s WOSB certification adds a federal contracting advantage.
